name: Olga Klose
source:
A woman able to perform healing miracles since she was a child. She was awarded the title of "Healing Saint" by the Vatican. The Vatican deeply trusts her and people love her. She is a simple, serious, and kind Onee-san type. 

[Based on the [url=http://www.littlewitch.jp/home/special/LWRQ/pg115.html]official site[/url]]
